references.text: Jesus uses the expression again to illustrate the principles of the kingdom of heaven, especially in the parable of the workers in the vineyard.
Mark repeats the same concept as part of Jesus' teaching, emphasizing that many who are first will be last, and the last first.
Luke includes a similar statement in the context of Jesus' answer to the question of who will be saved.
In Revelation, the concept of the first and the last is used in a different context, related to those who are called, chosen, and faithful.
